requirements.title: View-only trip members and copying a trip
requirements.description: Trip owners can make an invited member view-only. View-only members see the plan, costs and shared checklists but cannot change them, and can copy the trip to their own account to plan it themselves.
requirements.source: Requested by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22
ac:
Given I own a trip with an accepted member
When I open Members & invites and set that member to View only
Then the member is stored in trips.viewerIds and shows as 'View only' in the member list

Given I am a view-only member of a trip
When I open the trip
Then I see a view-only banner, and controls to add, edit, reorder, tick or delete plan items, costs and shared checklist items are hidden or disabled

Given I am a view-only member
When I try to write plan items, costs, shared checklists or trip details (UI or API)
Then Firestore security rules reject the write

Given I am a view-only member
When I tap 'Copy this trip' and confirm
Then a new trip owned by me is created with the plan, checklists and estimated costs I chose, and I can edit it

Given I am the trip owner
When anyone tries to make me view-only
Then I keep full edit rights

requirements.title: Estimated vs actual cost comparison
requirements.description: Show estimated and actual costs side by side in one view so members can see the difference per item and spot costs that were not in the original estimate.
requirements.source: Requested by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22
ac:
Given a trip has estimated costs and actual costs recorded from them
When I open the Costs tab
Then a 'Estimated vs actual' card lists each estimate with its estimated amount, actual amount, and the difference marked over / under / on budget, with bars to compare

Given an estimate has no actual cost linked yet
When I view the comparison
Then it shows 'Not spent yet' and is counted in the 'not spent yet' note, not as a saving

Given some actual costs are not linked to any estimate (or their estimate was deleted)
When I view the comparison
Then they are listed under 'Not in the estimate' with their total, sorted by date

Given the comparison is shown
When I look at the footer
Then I see total estimated, total actual including extras, and the overall difference

requirements.title: Reorder costs by drag and drop
requirements.description: Members who can edit a trip can change the order of estimated and actual costs by dragging, and the order is saved for the whole group.
requirements.source: Requested by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22
ac:
Given I can edit the trip
When I hold the ⠿ handle of a cost and drag it up or down (mouse or touch), or press ↑ / ↓ on the handle
Then the cost moves to the new position and the new order is saved for everyone

Given costs have never been reordered
When I open the Costs tab
Then estimates keep the order they were added and actual costs are sorted by date

Given I am a view-only member
When I open the Costs tab
Then no drag handles are shown

requirements.title: Combined cost table: estimate, actual and difference in one table
requirements.description: Replace the separate Estimated and Actual tables with one table where each cost item shows its estimate, actual spend and difference on the same row. Users can add a cost with the estimate, the actual, or both at once, and record the actual later. Unplanned actual costs appear in the same table, marked. Field sets for estimate and actual stay the same.
requirements.source: Requested by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22 (refines REQ-002)
ac:
Given I can edit a trip
When I tap 'Add a cost' and fill the estimate and/or the 'Already paid' part
Then one estimate and/or one actual cost is saved; if both, the actual is linked to the estimate

Given a cost item has an estimate only
When I tap 🧾 on its row and save the actual amount
Then the actual is linked to that item and the row shows estimate, actual and difference

Given an item has one or more actual payments
When I view the table
Then the row shows the total actual, the difference (over in red, under in green) and each payment underneath with date, who paid and who shares it

Given an actual cost is not linked to any estimate
When I view the table
Then it appears as its own row tagged 'Unplanned' with no estimate and a + difference

Given the table has rows
When I look at the last row
Then I see total estimate, total actual and total difference, plus notes for unplanned and not-yet-spent amounts

Given I am a view-only member
When I view the table
Then I see all values but no add, edit, delete or drag controls

requirements.title: Highlight the selected place on the map
requirements.description: When a place is selected (place panel open), its pin stands out so users can tell which of dozens of pins they are looking at.
requirements.source: Requested by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22
ac:
Given the map shows many pins
When I open a place (from the map, search, a list or a trip plan)
Then its pin is larger, has a honey ring and a gently pulsing glow, and shows the place name in a label

Given the selected place is a famous place inside a cluster
When I open it
Then its highlighted pin is shown on its own and not hidden in the cluster

Given a place is selected
When I close the place panel or open another place
Then the highlight moves to the new place or disappears

Given my device asks for reduced motion
When a place is selected
Then the glow does not animate

requirements.title: Estimated costs for picked people
requirements.description: Besides 'Group' and 'Per person', an estimated cost can apply to picked people only (e.g. a side tour two of four members join). The amount is either a total split between them or per picked person.
requirements.source: Requested by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22
ac:
Given I add or edit an estimated cost
When I choose 'Pick people', select members and choose 'Total' or 'Per person'
Then the estimate is saved with those members (splitAmong) and the hint shows the per-person share or the total for them

Given 'Pick people' is chosen
When no member is selected
Then I cannot save and see 'Pick at least one person'

Given an estimate applies to picked people
When I view the cost tables and the PDF
Then its group total counts only the picked people, the label lists their names, and 'Estimated / person' shows the group average

Given an estimate applies to picked people
When I record its actual cost (🧾 or 'Already paid')
Then the actual form is pre-filled to split between the same people

requirements.title: Reliable cost ordering and an easier way to sort
requirements.description: Fix drag-and-drop ordering of costs (rows jumped back or stopped following the pointer) and add easier options: ↑/↓ buttons on each row and a Sort menu (group order, date paid, amount, most over budget, name) that can be saved as the group order.
requirements.source: Requested by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22
ac:
Given I can edit a trip and the table is in group order
When I drag a row by ⠿ (mouse or touch) or tap ↑ / ↓
Then the row moves, stays in its new place without jumping back, and the order is saved for the group in one write

Given the cost table has several rows
When I choose Sort by date, amount, most over budget or name
Then the table re-sorts on my device only, drag handles and ↑ ↓ are hidden, and a hint explains it

Given I sorted the table by something other than group order
When I tap 'Save as group order'
Then that order becomes the group order for everyone and the menu returns to 'Group order'

Given I am a view-only member
When I open the table
Then I can change my view sort but cannot reorder or save the group order

requirements.title: Costs PDF matches the web table and current order
requirements.description: The costs PDF uses one table like the web (item, estimate, actual, difference, payments under each item, unplanned rows marked) and follows the exact order currently shown on screen, using the latest data.
requirements.source: Requested by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22
ac:
Given I am on the Costs tab
When I tap Export PDF or Share PDF
Then the PDF shows a single table with Item, Estimate, Actual and Difference, each item's payments listed under it, unplanned costs marked, and a totals row

Given I reordered or sorted the table
When I export the PDF
Then rows appear in the same order as on screen

Given a cost was just added or edited
When I export the PDF
Then the PDF includes the latest values

Given a cost title contains arrows such as 'SGN → SIN'
When I export the costs PDF (or the plan PDF)
Then the arrows appear in the PDF instead of disappearing

requirements.title: Correct cost summary
requirements.description: The summary cards no longer subtract unspent estimates from the difference. Cards: estimated for the group (with per-person average), actually spent (incl. unplanned), difference on spent items, and estimated but not spent yet.
requirements.source: Requested by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22
ac:
Given some estimates have no actual cost yet
When I view the summary
Then 'Difference (spent items)' compares actual spend with the estimates of the items already paid plus unplanned costs, and the unspent estimates are shown separately as 'Estimated, not spent yet'

Given the PDF is exported
When I read its summary and totals row
Then they use the same numbers as the web

requirements.title: View-only trip link for non-members
requirements.description: The trip owner can turn on a view-only link so anyone with it (signed in or not) can view the plan and shared checklists, and costs if the owner allows, without joining the trip.
requirements.source: Requested by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22
ac:
Given I own a trip
When I open Members & invites → Code / link and turn on 'Anyone with the link can view'
Then the trip gets publicView and I can copy the view-only link

Given the link is on
When someone who is not a member (or not signed in) opens it
Then they see the trip header, Plan and shared Checklists (Costs only if 'Also show costs' is on) with a 'shared trip' banner, and no edit, member, invite, map, recap or Journey controls

Given I view a shared trip by link
When I tap 'Copy this trip'
Then I am asked to sign in if needed and then get my own editable copy

Given the owner turns the link off
When someone opens the link
Then they can no longer see the trip

Given the link is on
When anyone tries to list trips, read the journey/photos, personal checklists, or write anything
Then Firestore rules deny it

requirements.title: Faster page loading
requirements.description: Pages load too slowly on phones. Load the map only when the Map page is opened, load the English dictionary only for English users, stop loading the profile page at start-up, defer detailed country borders, render long photo grids progressively, and render map pins in the background.
requirements.source: Requested by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22 after the performance test
ac:
Given I open Trips, Guides, Explore, Memories or About
When the page loads
Then the map code (Leaflet, MapLibre, country borders) is not downloaded

Given my language is Vietnamese
When the site loads
Then the English dictionary is not downloaded; switching to English downloads it first and then switches

Given Explore or Memories has many photos
When I open it
Then about 24 cards render first and more render as I scroll

Given the mobile Lighthouse test (4G) is run on Trips, Guides, Explore and About
When compared with the baseline
Then Largest Contentful Paint and Total Blocking Time are lower than before (baseline: LCP 6.5–7.1 s, TBT 0.6–1.2 s)

requirements.title: Journey hides places removed from the trip plan
requirements.description: Places deleted from the trip plan kept appearing in the Journey tab, the stop count and the trip recap (and looked like they came back). The Journey now hides places whose plan items were all removed; adding the place again shows it again. No check-in data is deleted.
requirements.source: Reported by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22
ac:
Given a place was checked in for the trip and later deleted from the Plan
When I open the trip
Then it no longer appears in Journey, the stop count or the trip recap

Given I add that place to the plan again
When I open Journey
Then it appears again

Given I duplicate the trip
When the copy is created
Then places deleted from the original plan are not copied

requirements.title: About page: group related features, important first
requirements.description: In 'And there's more', features are grouped (Travel together, Costs & splitting, Guides & packing, Map & discovery, Handy extras) with the most important first in each group, instead of newest first.
requirements.source: Requested by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22
ac:
Given I open the About page
When I scroll to 'And there's more'
Then features appear under group headings, related features side by side, the most important first

Given a new feature is not yet assigned to a group
When it is released
Then it still appears, in the last group

requirements.title: Trip header shows length and the right place count
requirements.description: Link viewers saw '0 stops' because they cannot read the Journey. The header now shows the trip length (days/nights) for everyone, the number of planned places for link viewers, and the Journey stop count for members.
requirements.source: Approved by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22
ac:
Given a trip has start and end dates
When anyone opens it
Then the header shows e.g. '🌙 5 days 4 nights'

Given I view a trip by its view-only link
When I look at the header
Then I see '📍 N places' from the plan instead of '0 stops'

Given I am a member
When I look at the header
Then I still see the Journey stop count

requirements.title: Faster first paint: non-blocking CSS and CSS per page
requirements.description: Pages still felt slow. (C) The main stylesheet no longer blocks the first paint: the boot screen (inline CSS) shows at once while the CSS loads in parallel, and the app renders once it is ready. (D) Styles used by only one area (admin, about, guides, gear, tips, legal, profile, trips, share studio, feedback, map) move into their own CSS files that load with that area's code, so the shared stylesheet is much smaller.
requirements.source: Approved by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22 ('hãy làm luôn C và D')
ac:
Given I open any page
When the HTML arrives
Then the boot screen paints without waiting for the main CSS file

Given the main CSS has not finished loading
When the app is about to render
Then it waits for the CSS (max 4s) so I never see an unstyled page

Given I open a page such as Guides or About
When it loads
Then only the shared CSS plus that page's CSS are downloaded, and the page looks the same as before

requirements.title: Journey shows the itinerary date for visited places
requirements.description: Places ticked as visited from the plan showed the day they were ticked (e.g. 22/11) instead of the day in the itinerary. The Journey now shows, for each stop: the memory's date for check-ins with photos; the plan date for places that are in the plan; otherwise the saved date. It is ordered by that date, newest first. Works for existing data without any migration.
requirements.source: Reported by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22
ac:
Given a place in the plan for 18/11 was ticked visited on 22/11
When I open the Journey
Then it shows 18/11

Given a check-in memory dated 17/11
When I open the Journey
Then it shows 17/11

Given stops with different dates
When I open the Journey
Then they are ordered by the shown date, newest first

requirements.title: Admin can fix the location of famous places with a Google Maps link
requirements.description: In Admin → Places, the Google Maps link box and latitude/longitude were only shown for places the team added. Famous places (curated list / Wikidata) could not be moved when their pin was wrong. The editor now shows the link box and coordinates for every place; moved coordinates are saved in the place override and the map uses them.
requirements.source: Requested by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22
ac:
Given I edit a famous place such as Ha Long Bay
When I paste a Google Maps link and press Find
Then the latitude and longitude fill in

Given I save with new coordinates
When anyone opens the map
Then the pin shows at the new place

Given I reset the place's edits
When the map reloads
Then the original location is used again

requirements.title: Edit the text of a checklist item
requirements.description: Members can change the wording of a checklist item when plans change instead of deleting and re-adding it. Tap ✏️ (or double-click the text), Enter or click away to save, Esc to cancel. Ticks, who-ticked and the item's scope are kept. View-only members cannot edit shared lists. Behind the flag checkEdit.
requirements.source: Requested by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22
ac:
Given a checklist item 'Mua eSIM'
When I tap ✏️, type 'Mua eSIM Singapore' and press Enter
Then the item shows the new text for everyone and stays ticked if it was ticked

Given I am editing an item
When I press Esc or clear the text
Then nothing changes

Given I am a view-only member
When I open a shared checklist
Then I do not see ✏️

requirements.title: Journey shows the check-in date the user entered
requirements.description: Check-ins with photos showed the upload day (e.g. 18/11) instead of the check-in date the user entered, because trip stops were saved without a date and were not updated when a check-in was edited. Now: stops save the check-in date; editing a check-in's date, caption or trip replaces my stop in the Journey; and the Journey uses the date of my own check-ins directly, so existing stops show the right date at once.
requirements.source: Reported by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22
ac:
Given I checked in at Chinatown with date 10/11 but uploaded on 18/11
When I open the trip's Journey
Then it shows 10/11

Given I change a check-in's date to 11/11
When anyone in the trip opens the Journey
Then it shows 11/11

Given I move a check-in to another trip
When I open both Journeys
Then it appears only in the new trip

requirements.title: Admin-corrected coordinates apply everywhere
requirements.description: After REQ-018 an admin could fix a place's coordinates, but only the famous-places list used them. Saved places (visited / wishlist), check-ins, the open place, trip stops and plan items, map fly-to and Directions still used the old coordinates. Now all of them use the corrected coordinates.
requirements.source: Reported by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22
ac:
Given an admin moved Ha Long Bay with a Google Maps link
When I open Ha Long Bay from the map, my visited places, a check-in or a trip plan
Then the pin and the map zoom use the new location

Given the same place
When I tap Directions
Then Google / Apple Maps open with the new coordinates

Given the admin resets the place
When the map refreshes
Then the original location is used again

requirements.title: Directions open the Google Maps link the admin attached
requirements.description: When Google Maps receives bare coordinates it labels the destination with the nearest named point (e.g. 'Ramayana Cave' for Batu Caves). When an admin fixes a place with a Google Maps link (Find place), the link is saved with the place; Directions → Google Maps then opens that exact place page (name, photos, Directions button). Clearing the link box removes it. Only https Google Maps links are accepted.
requirements.source: Approved by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22
ac:
Given an admin pasted the Google Maps link of Batu Caves, pressed Find place and saved
When a user taps Directions → Google Maps on Batu Caves (from the map, a saved place or a trip)
Then Google Maps opens the Batu Caves page

Given the admin clears the link box and saves
When a user taps Directions
Then Google Maps opens with the coordinates as before

Given a link that is not an https Google Maps link
When it is saved
Then it is ignored

requirements.title: Safer release pipeline: deploy only after green CI, smoke test with rollback, library security audit
requirements.story: As the product owner, I want only tested code to reach beetheremap.com, and a broken release to be undone automatically, so that users never get a broken site.
ac:
Given a commit is pushed to main
When Compass CI fails
Then the site is not deployed

Given Compass CI is green for a commit on main
When the deploy runs
Then exactly that commit is built and deployed

Given a deploy finished
When the live site does not serve the new build with the Bee There title within 10 minutes
Then the last good version is redeployed and a bug issue is opened

Given CI runs
When a shipped library has a critical vulnerability
Then CI fails; the full audit report is shown in the run summary

Given I need to roll back by hand
When I run Compass Deploy with a commit SHA
Then that commit is deployed
requirements.source: Requested by the Product Owner on 2026-11-23 (issue #50)
